A: Does tighter 2024 constituency winner margin associate with higher turnout?

C.execution: V8 exact arithmetic over 650 derived GitHub rows; turnout=(valid+invalid)/electorate, margin=majority/valid; Pearson/Spearman with average ranks; four equal observation quartiles, OLS slope, quadratic R2 check.

F: Supports negative descriptive association in this mirror sample; explains only 8.2% turnout variance in unadjusted OLS; nonlinear term adds essentially zero in-sample R2. Cannot call competitiveness causal since margin itself produced by votes cast.
G: Same-election historical endpoint and post-election margin, no prospective pre-election signal or independent time replicate; published 2024 results have been updated by 2026.
I: No inference about turnout of named electorate groups
J: Test candidate fragmentation independent marginal utility.
